Kessler Investment Group Maintains Holding in Citigroup (C); Lombard Odier Asset Management Usa Holding in Gilead Sciences (Call) (GILD) Trimmed as Valuation Declined
June 29, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Kessler Investment Group Llc increased its stake in Citigroup Inc (C) by 17958.29% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kessler Investment Group Llc bought 31,427 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 31,602 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.13 million, up from 175 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kessler Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $170.54 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.17% or $1.42 during the last trading session, reaching $66.88. About 19.86M shares traded or 16.82% up from the average. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 10.48% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.09% the S&P500.
